name: Broken Alliances
summary: Gorn sends you east into Lethlor Ravine to free two black drakes bound by the Seal of the Earth. This follows the first Broken Alliances.

sections.title: Three Runestones
sections.body:
Three runestones keep the Seal of the Earth closed, one in each of Lethlor Ravine’s Diamond, Opal and Amethyst pillars. Gorn gives you the Sign of the Earth, which draws the stones out and opens the seal.

Countless drakes live in the ravine, and Blacklash and Hematus are formidable foes. Gorn wants both dead, with their bindings brought back to him.

sections.title: What Gorn Makes of It
sections.body: Gorn says the black dragonflight remains allied with the renegade Blackrock orcs. He believes dragons and orcs alike must be reined in or cast out. With Blacklash and Hematus dead, the Horde can look west toward Blackrock Spire.

faq.answer: Gorn sends you into Lethlor Ravine, as the next step after the first Broken Alliances.

aliases: how to get to lethlor ravine
faq.answer: Lethlor Ravine lies at the far eastern end of the Badlands, where countless drakes make their home.

faq.q: How do you free Blacklash and Hematus?
faq.answer: Use the Sign of the Earth to draw a runestone from each of the three pillars. Set the stones into the Seal of the Earth to free both drakes.

faq.q: What must be brought back to Gorn?
faq.answer: Once both drakes are dead, bring Gorn the bindings of Blacklash, the chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth.
